name: BrokerIA Imoveis
description: Search real estate listings from Brazilian agencies using natural language. Powered by semantic vector search, BrokerIA understands queries like "cozy apartment near schools in Campinas under 300k" and returns relevant properties with photos, prices, and details. Simulate mortgage payments (SAC/PRICE systems), register as a qualified lead, and schedule property visits directly from the chat. Currently serving 300+ properties from 10+ real estate agencies across Brazil.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BrokerIA Imoveis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BrokerIA Imoveis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brokeria.com.br/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BrokerIA Imoveis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BrokerIA Imoveis provides these MCP tools: brokeria_buscar_imoveis, brokeria_detalhes_imovel, brokeria_simular_financiamento, brokeria_qualificar_lead, and brokeria_agendar_visita.

_published_faq.name: Does BrokerIA Imoveis MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BrokerIA Imoveis does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
BrokerIA Imoveis is developed by BrokerIA Tecnologia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
